processes:task-ao-improve-transform-8f3j.plain_language_name: Run the Transition Steps Across Units, Roles, and Agents
processes:task-ao-improve-transform-8f3j.plain_language_description: With the sequence verified, the processing custodian runs the transition itself: each sequenced step is carried out across the affected units, roles, and agents, and the executed transition is set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers from the execution are preserved.
processes:task-ao-improve-transform-8f3j.business_purpose: It exists because a sequenced change only happens when somebody actually runs its steps in order.
processes:task-ao-improve-transform-8f3j.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified sequence is ready to be run, and it ends with the executed structure transition produced and the working papers kept for audit.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian runs each transition step in its order across the affected units, roles, and agents, recording what was executed.

processes:task-ao-improve-verify-3jd7uv.plain_language_name: Check the Sequence Before Running the Steps
processes:task-ao-improve-verify-3jd7uv.plain_language_description: Before any step runs, the verification custodian checks the sequenced transition against what execution requires - that the steps are complete, ordered without gaps, and ready to move the organisation through the bounded change. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before any step runs.
processes:task-ao-improve-verify-3jd7uv.business_purpose: It exists so the organisation is never moved by a sequence that was incomplete or out of order.
processes:task-ao-improve-verify-3jd7uv.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the sequence can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the sequence jumping from one step to another with no handover between and logs the defect before anything runs.

processes:task-ao-improve-record-mb7s4u.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the handover trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. processes:task-ao-improve-record-mb7s4u.business_purpose: It exists so the accountability movements of the reorganization can be evidenced long after the change has settled.
processes:task-ao-improve-record-mb7s4u.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the handover trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a responsibility query would consult.

processes:task-ao-improve-confirm-vkuayw.plain_language_description: When the handovers stand logged, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation.
